opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ga. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 819.] Motion of respondent for leave to proceed further herein in forma pauperis granted. Motion of J. Reese Franklin, Esquire, and W. S. Perry, Esquire, to withdraw as counsel for respondent granted. Motion of respondent for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that Manley F. Brown, Esquire, of Macon, Ga., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
